failedR1.reason: QA kept walking while turning near the entry target and circled at roughly 0.8 m. Its cleanup also read the Office walking flag before observer presentation returned, despite players already zero.

operation.scope: Original native aircraft acceptance scope plus authoritative HUD, taxi, passenger isolation and modal neutralization. No airborne browser trajectory.

requirements.requirement: Keep original flight controls through the Office entry
requirements.evidence: Actual airport walk/pilot boarding; trusted pitch, roll, rudder, throttle and brake; matching replicated servos; modal neutralization and passenger isolation. Original mixed airborne input also has 900 sequential sampler comparisons in the adapter suite.

requirements.requirement: Preserve flight trajectory and original aircraft geometry with Engine physics
requirements.evidence: 23 tests include real SolidWorld takeoff, loss of lift without wings, W/Down rotation, ISA thrust, loops/rolls, seat ownership/stale input, negative-chunk runway collision and five original moving-mesh checks. Native airborne trajectory was not run here.

requirements.requirement: Restore original pilot instruments in Office without another simulation
requirements.evidence: Authority readouts are passed as a cloned, finite, matching-vehicle FlightInstruments model; live HUD values agree with authority and disappear on exit. Missing/stale/NaN data are covered by adapter context checks.

requirements.requirement: Preserve original Game behavior and save data
requirements.evidence: Runtime VehicleInstruments body is byte-identical after type-only extraction; rebuilt game/controller/DSP hashes unchanged, existing Game PID retained, no missing/changed protected old records and old company ledger unchanged.

requirements.requirement: Complete full Engine replacement with the original game and Office entry
requirements.evidence: Subsystem ownership and original-feature completion audit remains open. This phase is not a complete integration claim.

failedProbes: Initial Office UI type check TS5097: importing through vehicle-instruments.ts pulled Game implementation dependencies into the UI compiler. A pure shared instrument model resolves it without weakening compiler options.
Native R1 circle/early-cleanup observations retained; R2 uses a stopped close approach and waits for observer presentation.
limits: No native airborne trajectory in this phase: native scope matches original qa-flight-browser.ts, extended with taxi/HUD/passenger/modal checks. Airborne dynamics are covered separately by unchanged original physics tests and sampler equivalence.
No new FPS or microphone claim.
The full integration remains active for subsystem/feature completion audit.
